title: Disciplining Deliberation: A Sociotechnical Perspective on Machine Learning Trade-offs

bias_targets.methodology: The paper conducts a theoretical and conceptual evaluation of algorithmic fairness. Rather than empirically measuring a specific bias, it uses a sociotechnical and set-theoretic framework to analyze formal trade-offs between predictive accuracy and statistical fairness (parity constraints across protected attributes), drawing on existing literature examples like differential validity in healthcare and lending disparities.
